summary: Highly experienced Senior Software Engineer with 45+ years in Silicon Valley, specializing in AI/ML platform development, automated testing, and diagnostic software. Proven expertise in building scalable ML infrastructure, productionizing models, and developing full-stack applications with Python, TypeScript, and cloud-native AI services. Passionate about applying Machine Learning for fault isolation, anomaly detection, and enhancing software development through GenAI.

items: AI-Assisted Development (Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot)

experience.title: Chief Consulting Engineer
bullets: Developed AI-powered 'Hire Me' tools suite using Vertex AI, Google Gemini, and Google Cloud Firestore, providing detailed job fit analysis and custom resume generation.
Built full-stack web applications (samkirk.com, Photo Fun) with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Google Cloud backend, integrating AI services for interactive experiences.
Pioneered GenAI-assisted software development using Cursor, Claude Code, and ChatGPT for full-stack development, testing, and up-to-date documentation.
Designed and implemented 'Tensor Logic' interactive demo, bridging neural and symbolic AI paradigms with a Rust/Axum backend and TypeScript/Vite frontend.

experience.title: Sr. Diagnostic Software Engineer
bullets: Co-designed and developed a test station for a Cooling Unit, including custom hardware and Python 2.7 software for 5 BeagleBone Black microcomputers.
Created telemetry event data log visualization using numpy, pandas, and matplotlib, constructing SQL databases for parsed, cleaned data.
Developed the host production test program for a rack's cooling unit within an existing Python framework for hi-speed digital logic emulation.
Implemented environmental data collection and logging synchronous with system-level test logging in Python for correlated time-series analysis.

experience.title: Test Engineer III - Embedded Software
bullets: Proposed and implemented a fully wrapped instrument testing approach with complete remote access for continuous integration and real target testing.
Created an API Reference document using a novel Sphinx extension, hosted on an internal web site, enhancing developer and chatbot readability.
Investigated and proposed solutions for bad audio output in prototype instruments, demonstrating strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
bullets: Developed a highly object-oriented test framework in Python 2.7 for automotive OTA firmware update testing, mediating between cloud server and vehicular hardware.
Revised the test framework for expansion and scalability, implementing three levels of logging and two levels of stop-on-fail control for execution.
Created extensive YAML configuration files for test parameterization and managed resources for modular, dynamically loaded test procedures.

experience.title: Sr. Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and implemented Span Adjustment, Drive Alignment, and Compare Alignment timing calibration for a 192-channel digital ATE instrument using C++.
Developed custom Python scripts for generating many different XML timing patterns, demonstrating early Python usage in test automation.
Co-designed 4 separate applications of a generic parallel, binary search object, applicable to efficient data processing and analysis.

additionalSections.title: Professional Vision
additionalSections.content: Committed to applying Machine Learning to improve diagnostic fault isolation and enable anomaly detection and forecasting of hardware faults (prognostics) using time-series analysis. Advocates for property-based testing with Python packages like Hypothesis and AI-assisted test code generation using tools like GitHub Copilot for white box environments. Proposes an ideal test stack architecture founded on C/C++ libraries wrapped with Python, leveraging public domain ML libraries and PyTest for measurement and evaluation. Utilizes block diagram-driven test methodology for precise fault isolation and inference through tagged test results, enhancing diagnostic capabilities.
